g.text: Native simulation · one clock, completed interrupt handoff
IRQ acknowledgement does not authorize more virtual time.
The notified homing worker must get a chance to run.
ThreadX ticks, STEP, feedback and display VSYNC share virtual time.
SDL input pumping and native peer watchdogs remain on wall time.
Slow host computation stretches wall duration instead of starving a worker
behind repeated simulated timer interrupts. GIGA firmware is unchanged.
Linux functional verification; this does not model Cortex-M execution time.
Source: Session.cpp; simulation/Client.cpp; ThreadX Linux scheduler hook; DisplayHost.cpp.
